caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair positioned at an angle such that both the front and left sides are visible. The chair has a backrest featuring a detailed carved design with interlocking oval and curved patterns, topped by a small, semi-circular fan motif at the center. The wood is depicted with brown tones and visible grain texture. The seat of the chair is a rectangular cushion covered in a greenish-blue fabric with subtle shading to indicate texture and depth, and the edge is adorned with small decorative brass-colored nailheads. The chair legs are straight and slightly tapered, connected by horizontal stretchers on all four sides. The background of the drawing is plain and light beige, with no additional objects or patterns, and there is a small signature "W. Mickhofel" in the lower right corner.
title: Salem Chair
